title: OpenAI acquires Ona, which offers cloud services to support AI agents, and plans to bring Ona's team into its Codex effort (Seth Fiegerman/Bloomberg)
summary: Seth Fiegerman / Bloomberg: OpenAI acquires Ona, which offers cloud services to support AI agents, and plans to bring Ona's team into its Codex effort — OpenAI has agreed to acquire Ona, a startup that offers cloud services to support artificial intelligence agents, part of a bid by the AI developer to make its technology more useful for businesses.
